text:
ashley: Repro: ruby-sdk segfault when using ffi gem + streaming-retry enabled. Minimal sample attached. Anyone seen this?

ben: Can you paste the Gemfile + exact command you ran?

ashley: Sure:
```
# Gemfile
source 'https://rubygems.org'
gem 'redwood-ruby-sdk', '~> 0.4'
gem 'ffi', '1.16.0'
```
Run: `ruby sample_stream.rb`

ashley: sample_stream.rb:
```
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], streaming: true)
stream = client.chat_stream(to: 'gpt-4o-mini') do |chunk|
  puts chunk.text
end
```
Segfault happens after ~2s on alpine-musl CI. Local macOS works.

marta: @ashley can you include `ruby -v` and `ldd` output of the ffi native lib?

ashley: ruby 3.2.2p123 on musl. ldd shows libffi linked to /usr/lib/libffi.so.7

sam: Is the SDK doing any FFI calls itself? Or is it purely from downstream gems?

ashley: The only native ext is from ffi; the SDK is pure Ruby. But it seems streaming retry path uses native buffers (C extension in dependency) -> maybe double-free.

leo: This sounds like the classic ffi + GC + thread race. Try disabling streaming retry: set `streaming: false` or `RETRY_STRATEGY=none` in env and repro.

ashley: Confirmed: no segfault with streaming=false. So a likely interaction between our retry thread and ffi memory.

dev-bot: PR opened by @ashley -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/912 : add integration test for ffi + streaming retry

marta: I'll take the PR for review. Can you add a minimal failing spec under spec/integration/ffi_stream_spec.rb and a CI matrix job for alpine-musl?

ashley: Pushed spec and CI tweak to branch. Locally it fails on alpine docker: exit code 139.

ben: If we backport, target 0.4.x patch? Breaking fix but small surface. Label `backport-candidate`.

marta: Added labels `needs-repro`, `priority/medium`, `backport-candidate`. Will review this afternoon. Thanks :thx:

ashley: Thanks all — will hang around for review and try to craft a minimal C repro if needed.
